title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over Ad

translated_title: MUON-RT：重用教师轨迹实现无动量Muon的大语言模型自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 对于采用指数移动平均（EMA）教师的大语言模型自蒸馏方法而言，学生更新的历史记录本身已被保留。然而，Muon优化器仍需存储一个单独的动量缓冲区，从而增加了持续的训练内存开销。我们提出了重用教师的Muon（Muon-RT），该方法通过重用教师-学生位移来消除隐藏层权重矩阵的动量缓冲区。我们证明，该位移编码了已应用更新的指数加权历史，并在局部模型下平滑了时间上不相关的噪声。Muon-RT去除该位移的径向分量，对其进行谱归一化，并在Newton-Schulz（NS）正交化之后将其与当前梯度混合。在明确的正则性与对齐性假设下，我们建立了期望目标差距界向残差误差水平的线性收缩。通过在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上进行自蒸馏微调（SDFT），Muon-RT相比AdamW等基线方法提升了平均准确率（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出Muon-RT，通过重用自蒸馏中教师与学生的位移替代Muon优化器的动量缓冲区，在降低训练内存开销的同时保证了理论收敛性，并提升大语言模型自蒸馏微调的性能。
en_tdlr: Muon-RT reuses the teacher-student displacement in self-distillation to eliminate Muon's momentum buffers, reducing training memory while ensuring theoretical convergence and improving LLM self-distillation fine-tuning performance.
